  WHY: In the described edge case, a command substitution can be misparsed when the final character happens to be whitespace or a separator.

- .claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py: lines 514-519 (issue_family_marker) | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: issue_family_marker searches the entire "outside" region of the issue body, which includes the "Reason Claude Code gave" section rendered from untrusted session reason text before the example block; on a legacy issue, a family marker embedded there can be returned and trusted by index_issues over legacy_issue_family.
  WHY: index_issues registers the issue under the forged family id; a subsequent prompt of that family can cause file_patterns to post its report as a comment on the wrong issue. The module docstring declares "Issue text is untrusted data," but this path trusts untrusted reason text for family assignment. Existing tests cover markers inside the example block and fence-spoofing, but not markers in the reason section.
